response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled, hands-on Staff Software Engineer with strong distributed systems and full-stack experience, but lacks the requisite executive leadership background for a CTO role. The position requires scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, managing outsourced partners, and possessing deep, production-grade experience architecting multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech environments, none of which are demonstrated in this resume.
strengths: Strong hands-on backend and distributed systems experience, including building high-throughput microservices.
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
Relevant baseline exposure to the fintech domain through engineering work at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Complete lack of executive engineering leadership experience or a track record of scaling teams.
Insufficient production experience architecting complex, stateful multi-agent AI workflows at scale.
No evidence of managing outsourced engineering partners or establishing enterprise-level technical governance.
